description.value: Disco Cheetah is a fast-casual Korean restaurant in Vancouver's Davie Village, specializing in Korean bowls and bao with a Western twist. The business evolved from a food truck launched in 2014 into a brick-and-mortar location that opened in 2019 in the lively, diverse Davie Village neighbourhood. Online ordering and catering services are available alongside a companion food truck that operates downtown on weekdays.
